conf.description: FireEye HX endpoint alert / CEF over syslog: hand-built CEF header + kvp extension parse (no Elastic integration, no Cribl Pack exists for HX). rule.name (ArcSight label-resolved cs slot) and the 0-10 severity normalization are left as documented gaps -- no live template to resolve the label against, no concrete severity scale given.

conf.comment: fireeye-hx / hx-alert / syslog-cef. Hand-built parse: CEF header regex_extract, then serde kvp on the extension blob. cs1/cs1Label indicator-name slot is NOT resolved (map says resolve by Label value, never slot number, and confirm in-tool -- no sample available, so rule.name is left unmapped rather than guessed). act/event.type and event.severity normalization use best-effort mappings per the map's transform text; dst-vs-src for host.ip and the fileHash algorithm are per the map's literal field names, flagged for live confirmation.

functions.description: record CEF parsing approach and the unresolved-label gap
split the 8 pipe-delimited CEF header fields from the extension blob
explode the space-separated key=value CEF extension into top-level fields
derive fields from ORIGINAL extension keys before renaming: UTC-assumed rt (epoch-ms or date string), duser domain-split, act->event.type lookup

batch rename every clean 1:1 field; event.severity is passed through as the raw CEF 0-10 integer (no concrete platform-wide scale was given -- see README gap); act's raw value is retained per the map's own instruction
tag event.dataset and drop consumed/redundant fields; cs*/cn* ArcSight slots are left in the event undisturbed since rule.name could not be resolved
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
